SELECT CPDS.REGIST_SEQNO registSeqno, CPDS.PROD_ID prodId, CPB.PROD_NAME prodName, CPDS.ISSUE_PARTY_ID issuePartyId, CPDS.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, CPDS.ORIGINAL_VALUE originalValue, CPDS.PRD_VALUE prdValue, CPDS.TOTAL_VALUE totalValue, CPDS.VALUE_CCY valueCcy, CPDS.CNY_ORL_VALUE cnyOrlValue, CPDS.CNY_PRD_VALUE cnyPrdValue, CPDS.CNY_TAL_VALUE cnyTalValue, CPDS.REA_YIELD*100 reaYield, CPDS.NEW_EXP_YIELD*100 newExpYield, CPDS.BANK_IMP_INT bankImpInt, TO_CHAR(CPDS.VDATE,'yyyyMMdd') vdate, TO_CHAR(CPDS.MDATE,'yyyyMMdd') mdate, CPDS.PURCHASE_QTY purchaseQty, CPDS.REDEEM_QTY redeemQty, CPDS.BALANCE_AMT balanceAmt, CPDS.PRD_QTY prdQty, CPDS.CCY_PURCHASE ccyPurchase, CPDS.SEND_STATUS sendStatus, CPDS.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS submitFeedbackStatus, CPDS.STATUS_DATE statusDate, CPDS.STATUS, CPDS.ORG_CODE orgCode, CPDS.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, CPDS.SUBMIT_TIME submitTime, CPDS.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE chbSubmitDeadline, CPDS.REMARK FROM CHB_PRD_DEAL_SUB CPDS
LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO CPB ON CPB.PROD_ID = CPDS.PROD_ID AND CPB.ORG_CODE = CPDS.ORG_CODE AND CPB.STATUS = 'E'
